summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Open Badges 2.0 features: GitHub link, LinkedIn 'Add to LinkedIn' button, superadmin logo upload, featured badges on About page, and Open Badges compliance (issuedOn format, iTXt metadata, font rendering).
passed_tests: GET /api/badges/featured returns 3 seeded founder badges with linkedin_add_url
LinkedIn URL structure includes all required parameters (startTask, name, organizationName, issueYear, issueMonth, certUrl, certId)
Assertion issuedOn format ends with 'Z' (ISO 8601 UTC: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ)
Identity hash consistency across all 3 seeded badges (sha256$b29ebd89336de7d3f140683aa1f4da0cfa4160c059f4a5155a51c0bd0e9ab566)
GET /api/badges/images/{slug}.png returns 200 for all 3 badges
GET /api/badges/assertions/{aid}/baked.png returns 200 for all 3 badges
Admin POST /api/admin/badges/logos accepts PNG/JPG/WebP, rejects text file (400), size validation exists
Admin GET /api/admin/badges/logos lists logos with path and in_use count
Admin DELETE /api/admin/badges/logos/{id} returns 409 when logo is in use by a badge
Admin POST /api/admin/badges with featured=true and send_email=false works correctly
Admin PATCH /api/admin/badges/{aid} updates featured flag
Admin endpoints return 401 without authentication
Badge rendering works without system fonts (uses bundled Liberation Sans fonts)
Baked PNG contains iTXt 'openbadges' metadata with assertion URL
Badge email HTML passes email_sender._assert_safe_email validation
About page /about: GitHub link https://github.com/ecouso1977 present in Leadership social links
About page: Founder credentials card (data-testid='founder-credentials') displays 3 badges with images and links
All 3 badges link to correct /credentials/{aid} pages
Verify page /credentials/{aid}: LinkedIn button (data-testid='credential-linkedin-button') present for all 3 badges
LinkedIn button href starts with https://www.linkedin.com/profile/add? and includes all required parameters
LinkedIn button opens in new tab (target='_blank')
Badge images load on all 3 verify pages
Regression: Homepage / loads successfully
Regression: /blog loads successfully
Regression: /book loads successfully
Regression: All 3 credential pages load (26ce7f3d-4dca-54b2-8dbf-9eea1af888aa, 6b0bc72a-ffec-5a0c-9d8d-1d8c310a35a7, 092afa88-01cc-53ff-8633-348217e4e816)
